# braintrust_group_membership (Resource)

Manages one user's membership in a Braintrust permission group without managing the group's other members. Use it for built-in groups or groups managed outside Terraform. Do not combine it with `member_users` on the same `braintrust_group`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "org_id" {
  type = string
}

data "braintrust_group" "engineers" {
  name   = "Engineers"
  org_id = var.org_id
}

data "braintrust_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "braintrust_group_membership" "alice_engineer" {
  group_id = data.braintrust_group.engineers.id
  user_id  = data.braintrust_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Permission group ID.
- `user_id` (String) Member user ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in group_id/user_id form.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with group_id/user_id.
terraform import braintrust_group_membership.example <group_id>/<user_id>
```
